reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the owner-operator and respects Bareni's boundaries and no-CTA rule. Minor slip using first-person singular ('My practical check') instead of public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: Logical flow with an immediate main point, clear criteria, and plain language distinguishing manual tasks from repeatable workflows.
reasons.actionability: Provides an explicit diagnostic threshold and a concrete, feasible logging exercise to decide on automation viability.
reasons.factual_grounding: Fully grounded in approved evidence, correctly noting Bareni's scope exclusions regarding high-sensitivity domains and emphasizing human approval.
